item.title: Platform or Point Solution?
item.description: A while back, I wrote a post titled “What is a Platform?”. I defined what a platform is and why tech companies are so determined to become labeled as one. My definition of a platform is a tool that allows users to define and build their own things, which can be used by other users. Tech companies wish to own platforms, as they are the engines that propel the flywheel toward infinite growth.

item.title: Trust and Procedural Fetishism
item.description: I recently finished reading Abundance by Ezra Klein and Derek Thompson.
